item.title: ACTEC Announces Peter S. Gordon as New President
item.description: ACTEC today announced that Peter S. Gordon will serve as the 2025–2026 President. Gordon is a Director at Gordon, Fournaris & Mammarella, P.A. in Wilmington, DE. He succeeds 2024–2025 ACTEC President Susan D. Snyder, a Senior Planner on Northern Trust’s Regional Wealth Advisor Team in Chicago, IL

item.description: The College is pleased to announce that 34 individuals were elected: 26 Fellows, one Academic Fellow, three Fiduciary Counsel Fellows, two International Fellows from Canada, one International Fellow from Japan, and Russell N. item.title: ACTEC Elects 29 New Fellows to the College
item.description: The College is pleased to announce that 29 individuals were elected: three Academic Fellows; two International Fellows (one from Canada and one from China); one Fiduciary Counsel Fellow and 23 private practice Fellows. Ten New Fellows are graduates of an ACTEC Fellows Institute.
